name: isocan
description: An isomorphic canvas: one 2.5D surface, driven from a web app and a terminal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @isocan/server" "npm run dev -w @isocan/web"

//: The runtime deps the CLI needs are declared HERE as well as in packages/cli, so that `npm i -g github:dglazkov/isocan#release` (no publishing) resolves them: a git install installs the root package only. @types/node rides along for the API's consumers — `connect()`'s surface names Buffer, so an install must carry the type. The workspaces themselves are deliberately NOT dependencies — bin/workspace-loader.mjs resolves them by path, because link dependencies break every reinstall. `workspaces` and `prepare` are why installs come from the release branch and not from here: npm's git installer empties the install directory for any package it thinks it must build first (#47, scripts/release.mjs).
